approach: make copilot-cli a derived-output vendor: plugin build derives com.github.copilot/{agents,commands,rules,hooks/hooks.json,lsp.json} from the canonical manifest and passes an authored extensions/ through; the manifest stays canonical at root plugin.json

scope: the five component kinds the runtime changelog names as moved, plus extensions pass-through. skills/ and mcp.json stay at the plugin root and are out of scope. outputStyles is not a Copilot kind and is out of scope.

knock-on: ADR-0011's 'copilot-cli is warned about, never derived for' rule no longer holds for hooks -- copilot now has a derived hooks file, so an unrepresentable handler is dropped from it rather than reported as ignored at runtime. ADR-0013's dependency rule and the harness-override warning are unaffected: both concern manifest content, and the manifest is still canonical.

freeze handling: two frozen scenarios in plugin/build/build.feature are rewritten (copilot-cli derives nothing; copilot-cli warns an unsupported handler is ignored at runtime). Both assert behavior the runtime has since made wrong. Clearance pre-authorized by the CR, which asks for exactly this reversal.

high blast radius (build engine + doctor + examples + docs + two ADRs' consequences) but a single coherent concern -> auto-all: self-assert both gates within leash after a cold judge passes; Conflict and Compatibility still stop.
